label: pretrain_midrun
scored_by: dna_decode.glm.falsifier.run_falsifier (the committed scorer, not a copy)
direction: distinguishability from natural sequence; LOWER IS BETTER

leak_gate.meaning: windows the committed falsifier scores against are excluded from training, so a generator cannot be trained on the sequences it is graded on

interpretive_guard.why: a model trained mostly on organisms it is never scored against will score poorly for a reason unrelated to its architecture; attributing that to the model is the mistake this guard exists to prevent

power_gate_finding.what: positional-ONLY mode FAILS the committed falsifier's power gate, so run_falsifier returns INSTRUMENT_UNDERPOWERED and emits NO number for it
power_gate_finding.why: the gate is calibrated on UNIFORM sequence, which is an easy target that a 256-dimensional k-mer histogram crushes. Positional features are WEAKER against uniform and STRONGER against the Markov null -- the target that actually matters. So the gate rejects the mode that is best at the hard task because it is worse at the easy one.
power_gate_finding.consequence: `both` passes at 0.9494 AND carries the positional block, so it is the practical route to positional signal through the committed scorer. This WEAKENS the case for scoring on positional alone, whose advantage over `both` was never resolvable (-0.0364, interval crossing zero) and was feature economy rather than score.
power_gate_finding.not_resolved_here: whether MIN_POWER_AUROC or the uniform control is the right calibration for positional features is an instrument decision, not this script's to make

honest_limits: A low distinguishability means the discriminator could not separate generated from natural sequence ON THE FEATURES IT SEES. All three modes see LOCAL composition and positional composition; none sees long-range organisation, so clearing them is NECESSARY and not sufficient for functional realism.

The generator produces one sample set per run at a single sampling seed; the per-seed variation reported here is the SCORING seed, not generator sampling variance. A full account would resample the generator too.
The perfect-generator floor is empirical at one draw per seed and carries its own sampling variation.
positional mode is NOT in the committed grid, which scores kmer and both. Its numbers here are new cells, not a re-reading of any recorded result.
Beating the Markov null on these features is the arm's stated bar. It is not evidence that generated sequence is biologically functional, which needs a wet-lab or an oracle-scored design task.
